brief: The niche newsletter business plan. Topic selection, audience math, monetization stack, how to choose a niche AI can amplify.

slots.author: Maya Kern
slots.headline: The Niche Newsletter Business Plan
slots.body: Turn a tiny audience into a six-figure newsletter business. Here is the exact plan to pick, validate, and monetize your niche.

slots.author: Maya Kern
slots.title: Pick a Painful Problem
slots.body: The best niches solve expensive problems for specific people. If they feel the pain daily, they will pay for answers.

slots.author: Maya Kern
slots.title: Size Your Audience
slots.body: You only need ten thousand true fans. Sell a fifty-dollar product to one percent and earn five thousand monthly.

slots.author: Maya Kern
slots.title: Let AI Amplify It
slots.body: Choose a niche where AI speeds research, writing, or personalization. Your leverage multiplies when technology does the heavy lifting.

slots.author: Maya Kern
slots.title: Build the Monetization Stack
slots.body: Combine sponsorships, premium subs, and digital products. Multiple income streams make your newsletter recession-proof and highly profitable.

slots.author: Maya Kern
slots.title: Design the Flywheel
slots.body: One idea becomes a post, thread, newsletter, and course. Repurposing creates consistency without burning out each week.

slots.author: Maya Kern
slots.title: Validate in One Week
slots.body: Publish three posts on the topic. If engagement is high, you have proof. If not, pivot fast without regret.

slots.author: Maya Kern
slots.headline: Start Your Niche Newsletter
slots.body: Which niche will you dominate this year? Drop it in the comments and tag a founder who needs this plan.
